summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Scormify PowerPoint to SCORM converter. Backend APIs mostly functional (13/14 tests passed), frontend UI working well with proper slide workflow. Critical issue found with text element creation.

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 520 Internal Server Error when adding text elements
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks text element creation in editor
critical_bugs.details: Shape elements work fine, but text elements fail with 520 error

minor_issues.issue: Inconsistent slide data retrieval in some test scenarios

ui_bugs.issue: Text elements not appearing on canvas after API call
ui_bugs.details: Related to backend 520 error for text element creation

ux_issues.issue: New projects don't automatically create/select a default slide
ux_issues.details: Users see 'No slide selected' and must manually add/select slide first

ux_issues.issue: No error feedback when text element creation fails
Slide dropdown menu not easily accessible

integration_issues.issue: SCORM export dialog blocks other UI interactions

passed_tests: Editor page loads when opening project
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix critical text element creation issue - backend API /api/projects/{project_id}/slides/{slide_id}/elements returns 520 error for text elements. Also improve UX by auto-creating default slide for new projects.

success_percentage.frontend: 80% (most UI flows work, text elements blocked by backend issue)
